notes: Cash-basis (modified cash) school district; governmental funds only, no business-type funds (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here). Statements used: p5 receipts and p6 disbursements, Total Funds column; beginning 4,029,442 is the restated beginning fund balance (p6); roll-forward reconciles. Balance sheet from p1 Statement of Net Position, Governmental Activities column (component unit Foundation excluded). Detail: General Fund budget schedule pp8-10 (object detail not printed, so expenditure lines are not itemized; budget_final only printed as totals, left null); other fund schedules pp11-17. General Fund schedule (receipts 8,844,482, disbursements 8,727,920 incl. 85,450 transfers out) differs from the statement General column (8,847,125; 8,755,796); recorded as printed. Non-revenue lines on p8: transfer in and capital lease put in other financing; sale proceeds, insurance adjustment and other non-revenue receipts recorded as revenue (sale of assets, reimbursements/refunds, miscellaneous revenue) to match the top-level receipts split, all inside the printed Grand Total of All Receipts. The p7 combining schedule not recorded in detail (duplicates). Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds have no column on pp4-6 (folded into General). The printed p5 line Other/Donations/Non Revenue 265,775 (General 84,744 + Activity 181,031) is split into five receipts items (251,926) plus capital lease 3,651 (debt_proceeds) and transfer in 10,198 (in transfers_in); reported_totals receipts keeps the printed 9,451,545 with includes_split noting the 13,849 moved out. Read pages 1-17 of 17 General Fund budget schedule totals: revenue checked against the printed Grand Total of All Receipts 8,844,482 (p8, includes Total Other Financing Sources 77,694 of inflows only); the 85,450 transfer out is inside Total Disbursements 8,727,920 (p10), so no separate net other-financing total is recorded.
